description: For a finite context \(\Gamma\), derivability from \(\Gamma\) as an arbitrary theory agrees with the existing finite-context natural-deduction relation.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropositionalCompactness.theory_derives_finset.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α]
  (Γ : Finset (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropFormula α)) (C : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropFormula α) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropositionalCompactness.TheoryDerives (↑Γ) C ↔ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Derives Γ C
